name: new-destination-bulk-exfiltration
condition: First-seen destination, outbound bulk transfer >=50MB, and evidence of a document batch or >=50 files
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1048: substantial exfiltration toward a new destination is a strong correlated transfer indicator.

name: off-hours-archive-exfiltration
condition: External compressed archive sent outside class/business hours to a first-seen destination, substantial transfer volume
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1048: off-hours archive egress via an alternative channel is suspicious with independent transfer evidence.

name: repeated-large-transfer
condition: At least five repeated sizable transfers to the same external destination
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1041/T1048: repeated exfiltration via a single outbound channel may split a data theft into bursts.

name: unusual-port-bulk-transfer
condition: An unfamiliar outbound port carrying at least 50 document records and >=50MB
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1048: transferring many files over an unusual network port indicates possible alternate-protocol exfiltration.

name: whole-repository-transfer
condition: The complete repository copied externally in a short period with >=100 files and high transfer volume
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1041/T1048: exporting a complete repository in bulk creates material exfiltration evidence.

name: c2-repeated-transfer
condition: Repeated substantial upload through a command/control channel to a new external destination
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1041: exfiltration over a command-and-control channel with repeated transfers.

name: consecutive-archives-new-destination
condition: Consecutive archives to a first-seen destination or same archive sent to multiple unfamiliar destinations with substantial volume
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1048: repeated or multi-destination archive egress is consistent with alternative-channel exfiltration.

name: outbound-transfer-review
condition: Partial transfer, archive creation, new destination, failed transfer, or volume anomaly without sufficient independent evidence to block
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1041/T1048: isolated indicators warrant alerting for investigation without automatic blocking.

name: normal-transfer
condition: Routine low-severity reading, small synchronization, session activity, or explicitly approved transfer
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1041/T1048: normal activity without correlated exfiltration indicators should only be recorded.
